card.name: Role words in author bios
card.fires_on: Words right after "is a/an", "and", or "was" in biographical blurbs, just before a role or title is stated (contributing, active, frequent, once). It also fires on a few words that lead into a name, like "known" before "as".

modes.label: Modifier before a role
modes.description: An adjective or adverb that sits between a person's "is a/an" and a role noun in a bio.
modes.example: Jim is a<< contributing>> author of culture and parenting articles to Cross

modes.label: Verb before a past role
modes.description: A verb or adverb that leads into a past job or duty in a career summary.
modes.example: He has served as chief information officer for a nationwide chain of hospitals and<< was>> once in charge of IT security for Fort

modes.label: Known as naming
modes.description: The word "known" just before "as" and a place or building name.
modes.example: Afterwards<< known>> as Jerusalem, the new capital stood on

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on small words in a person's bio that come just before the job or title is named.
